name: Verify a synthetic cutout alignment
description: Synthetic observed workflow approved by a pseudonymous human reviewer.

trigger.condition: A synthetic cutout move has completed.

preconditions: The final synthetic drawing state is available.

inputs.name: final_synthetic_state
inputs.description: Final synthetic geometry state to inspect.

relevant_drawing_state.description: A synthetic enclosure face after cutout alignment.

ordered_actions.instruction: Measure the final synthetic centerline offset.

constraints: Use only the synthetic measurement shown in the evidence.

observable_outcomes: Measured offset meets the human-approved criterion.

known_exceptions.handling: Stop validation and return the candidate for human review.

human_approval_evidence.approval_basis: Pseudonymous expert reviewed the synthetic evidence and validation criterion.
